description: AICTIONBOT™ revised offer check by KULIC Advisory (tool 59). Takes the items of a first offer and of the revised offer from the same supplier and matches them by description, otherwise by item number. Splits the difference between the two totals into four parts: lower or higher prices of the same items, changed quantities, removed items and new items. Says whether the reduction is real (from prices) or comes from a smaller scope, lists every item that became more expensive, every removed and added item and every changed quantity, and ends with ready questions for the supplier and the next step. Pass two arrays (old_rows for round 1, new_rows for round 2) or one array rows with a round column (1 or 2). Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. To compare offers from different suppliers use compare_offers or score_offers. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

old_rows.description: Round 1: position (item number), description, quantity, unit_price, optionally total. German column names work too.

rows.description: Alternative to old_rows and new_rows: one list with a round column (1 or 2) plus the columns above.

name: compare_offer_rounds
title: Revised offer: is round 2 really cheaper? The difference split into price, quantity, removed and new items, with questions for the supplier
